name: Proof Console
concept: Six always-visible proof controls select one conceptual, copy-derived illustration inside a separate instrument plate.
silhouette: interactive reading rail + framed navy illustration artboard
focal_reason: The user-selected reason, with all six descriptions always visible
interaction: Click, touch, Arrow Up/Down, Home, and End select an illustration; a mobile cue shows which row is selected. No proof copy is gated.
safety: Illustrations are explicitly conceptual, not live Project Hub or search screens. Both claim qualifiers remain beside the corresponding descriptions.
